Program of Support for the Implementation of the Comprehensive Civic Coexistence

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a la prevencin y resolucin del delito, a travs del mejoramiento de: (i) la efectividad de la gestin institucional y operativa de la SSPN; (ii) la capacidad de investigacin del delito; y (iii) la gestin a nivel territorial de la convivencia y la seguridad ciudadana en los municipios beneficiados.

The program's general objective is to contribute to crime prevention and prosecution by improving: (i) the effectiveness of the institutional and operational management of the Department of SecurityNational Police Force; (ii) criminal investigation capacity; and (iii) management on the subnational level of civic coexistence and public safety in the beneficiary municipios.
